files_byte_size.name: files_byte_size
files_byte_size.value: "files"."byte_size" = octet_length("files"."bytes") and "files"."byte_size" between 1 and case "files"."purpose" when 'logo' then 262144 else 409600 end

files_dimensions.name: files_dimensions
files_dimensions.value: case "files"."purpose" when 'logo' then "files"."width" = 512 and "files"."height" = 512 else "files"."width" = 1600 and "files"."height" = 600 end

branch_hour_exceptions_periods.name: branch_hour_exceptions_periods
branch_hour_exceptions_periods.value: jsonb_typeof("branch_hour_exceptions"."periods") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("branch_hour_exceptions"."periods") <= 2 and "branch_hour_exceptions"."closed" = (jsonb_array_length("branch_hour_exceptions"."periods") = 0) and not jsonb_path_exists("branch_hour_exceptions"."periods", 'lax $[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || !(@.opensAt.type() == "string") || !(@.closesAt.type() == "string") || !(@.opensAt like_regex "^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$") || !(@.closesAt like_regex "^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$") || @.opensAt == @.closesAt)')

branch_hours_period.name: branch_hours_period
branch_hours_period.value: "branch_hours"."opens_at" <> "branch_hours"."closes_at" and extract(second from "branch_hours"."opens_at") = 0 and extract(second from "branch_hours"."closes_at") = 0

branches_name_latin.name: branches_name_latin
branches_name_latin.value: char_length("branches"."name_latin") between 2 and 100 and "branches"."name_latin" = btrim("branches"."name_latin") and "branches"."name_latin" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9 &''.-]+$'

branches_location.name: branches_location
branches_location.value: ("branches"."latitude_e7" is null) = ("branches"."longitude_e7" is null) and "branches"."latitude_e7" between -900000000 and 900000000 and "branches"."longitude_e7" between -1800000000 and 1800000000

branches_contact_phones.name: branches_contact_phones
branches_contact_phones.value: jsonb_typeof("branches"."contact_phones") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("branches"."contact_phones") <= 3 and not jsonb_path_exists("branches"."contact_phones", 'lax $[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || !(@.phone.type() == "string") || !(@.phone like_regex "^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$") || !(@.whatsapp.type() == "boolean"))') and coalesce("branches"."contact_phones"->0->>'phone' <> "branches"."contact_phones"->1->>'phone', true) and coalesce("branches"."contact_phones"->0->>'phone' <> "branches"."contact_phones"->2->>'phone', true) and coalesce("branches"."contact_phones"->1->>'phone' <> "branches"."contact_phones"->2->>'phone', true)

branches_currencies.name: branches_currencies
branches_currencies.value: "branches"."default_currency" in ('USD', 'TRY', 'SYP') and cardinality("branches"."accepted_currencies") between 1 and 3 and "branches"."accepted_currencies" <@ array['USD', 'TRY', 'SYP'] and "branches"."default_currency" = any("branches"."accepted_currencies") and cardinality("branches"."accepted_currencies") = ('USD' = any("branches"."accepted_currencies"))::int + ('TRY' = any("branches"."accepted_currencies"))::int + ('SYP' = any("branches"."accepted_currencies"))::int

branches_business_day_ends_at.name: branches_business_day_ends_at
branches_business_day_ends_at.value: "branches"."business_day_ends_at" between '00:00' and '08:00' and extract(minute from "branches"."business_day_ends_at") in (0, 30) and extract(second from "branches"."business_day_ends_at") = 0

tenants_name_latin.name: tenants_name_latin
tenants_name_latin.value: char_length("tenants"."name_latin") between 2 and 100 and "tenants"."name_latin" = btrim("tenants"."name_latin") and "tenants"."name_latin" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9 &''.-]+$'

tenants_status_reason.name: tenants_status_reason
tenants_status_reason.value: ("tenants"."status_reason" is not null) = ("tenants"."status" in ('suspended', 'closed')) and ("tenants"."status_reason" is null or "tenants"."status_reason" in ('non_payment', 'abuse', 'other'))

tenants_scheduled_status.name: tenants_scheduled_status
tenants_scheduled_status.value: ("tenants"."scheduled_status" is null or "tenants"."scheduled_status" in ('suspended', 'closed')) and ("tenants"."scheduled_status" is null) = ("tenants"."scheduled_status_reason" is null) and ("tenants"."scheduled_status" is null) = ("tenants"."scheduled_status_at" is null) and ("tenants"."scheduled_status_reason" is null or "tenants"."scheduled_status_reason" in ('non_payment', 'abuse', 'other'))

tenants_activated.name: tenants_activated
tenants_activated.value: "tenants"."status" not in ('active', 'suspended') or "tenants"."activated_at" is not null

tenants_activation_after_onboarding.name: tenants_activation_after_onboarding
tenants_activation_after_onboarding.value: "tenants"."activated_at" is null or "tenants"."onboarding_completed_at" is not null
